interface.name: kos_window_controls_manager_v1
interface.description: A client continues to draw its own controls until configure grants takeover. Only one controls object per surface is supported. Declaration also opts the surface out of legacy overlay placement, including while inactive.

request.name: set_region

description.summary: pending layout in surface logical coordinates

request.description: Position, size, diameter and gap apply on the next wl_surface.commit. Order is maximize, minimize, close from left to right. The compositor draws no background. enabled=0 retains the declaration but requests self drawing. Out-of-bounds or unsupported layouts are not accepted.

request.name: ack_configure

description.summary: synchronize drawing ownership with client content

request.description: Acknowledge the latest configure after switching client drawing. Ownership changes on the next wl_surface.commit. A stale serial is ignored.

event.name: configure
event.description: active=1 asks the client to hide its controls; active=0 asks it to draw them. glyph_mode is 0 for always, 1 for hover, including during fallback. The client must ack this serial and commit a frame even when active has not changed. Loss of the manager requires immediate client fallback.

request.name: set_buttons

description.summary: replace the complete button list atomically

request.description: Each entry is five native-endian 32-bit words: action (0=maximize/restore, 1=minimize, 2=close), then signed 24.8 fixed x, y, width, height in surface logical coordinates. Rectangles describe visible circular buttons: width and height must match, between 6 and 40. At most one of each action, no overlaps. Array order does not determine position. Empty lists draw and intercept nothing. A list replaces the entire previous layout on surface commit; omitted buttons disappear. Invalid lists request client fallback. enabled=0 retains declaration but requests client drawing. Version 1 set_region remains supported; new clients use set_buttons exclusively.
